report: SAĞ DİZ MRG.Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküste grade II dejenerasyon mevcuttur. Medial menisküste grade III dejenerasyonve arka boynuzda köke yakın radial yırtık izlendi.Ön çapraz bağ, lateral kollateral ligaman normaldir. Arka çapraz bağ komşuluğunda 15 mm çapında ve gastrokenimus  medial krus tendonu komşuluğunda 12 mm çapında ganglion kistleri izlenmiştir.Medial kollateral ligaman çevresinde hafif sıvı artışı mevcuttur.Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Patellar kıkırdakta medial fasette bütünlük kaybı, yer yer kemik yapıda milimetrik kist ve kemik iliği ödemi izlenmiştir (grade 4 kondromalazi ).Suprapatellar bursada sıvı artışı mevcuttur.Diz ekleminde hafif sıvı artışı izlenmiştir.Femur distal medial kondil düzeyinde ekleme bakan yüzlerde ve tibia medial plato düzeyinde kemik iliği ödemi izlenmiştir.Tibial ve femoral kartilajlarda yer yer bütünlük kaybı, dejeneratif değişiklikler izlenmiştir (dejeneratif artrit bulguları ).Tibia interkondiler tüberkül ACL insersiyosu düzeyinde subkondral milimetrik kistler izlenmiştir.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Sinovitis rodilla izquierda.
Hallazgos:
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Fibrilación marginal del cuerpo y cuerno posterior del menisco lateral.
Rotura compleja del cuerpo y cuerno posterior del menisco medial con extrusión asociada y
segmento desplazado receso menisco tibial, predominando a nivel del cuerpo. Edema las partes
blandas de manera difusa.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial y total de la zona de carga del compartimento femorotibial
medial con cambios óseos secundarios de predominio periférico.
Cartílagos de del compartimento femorotibial lateral y de la tróclea femoral sin alteraciones.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial la faceta medial de la rótula.
Moderado derrame articular con sinovitis difusa.
Tendones cuadricipital, rotuliano, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial
dentro de límites normales.
Impresión:
Rotura compleja del menisco medial con extrusión asociada y segmento desplazado receso
menisco femoral. Úlceras condrales de espesor total de la zona de carga del compartimento
femorotibial medial con cambios óseos secundarios.
Fibrilación marginal del cuerpo y cuerno posterior del menisco lateral.
Condropatía rotuliana con lesiones grado 2.
Moderado derrame articular con sinovitis difusa

TEXNIKΗ: Η εξέταση διενεργήθηκε σε Μαγνητικό Τομογράφο 3Τ. Ελήφθησαν ακολουθίες Τ1, Τ2 και STIR. ΔΙΑΓΝΩΣΗ: - Από τον έλεγχο του έσω διαμερίσματος παρατηρείται στένωση του μεσάρθριου διαστήματος με λέπτυνση και κατά τόπους ολική διάβρωση του αρθρικού χόνδρου, στο πλαίσιο εκφυλιστικής οστεοαρθρίτιδας έσω διαμερίσματος. - Από τον έλεγχο του οστικού μυελού παρατηρείται οστεομυελικό οίδημα στην εγγύς επίφυση της κνήμης κατά τον έσω κόνδυλο, με συνοδό ελάχιστο περιεχόμενο μικροδοκιδώδες κάταγμα στην υποχόνδρινη μοίρα, μήκους 9 mm,στο πλαίσιο κατάγματος ανεπάρκειας (SIFK). - Φυσιολογικά απεικονίζονται οι μηνίσκοι, οι χιαστοί και οι πλάγιοι σύνδεσμοι. - Δεν παρατηρούνται παθολογικά ευρήματα από τον έλεγχο του εκτατικού μηχανισμού. - Μικρή συλλογή υγρού παρατηρείται ενδαρθρικά. - Ολικού πάχους σχισμή παρατηρείται στον αρθρικό χόνδρο της επιγονατίδας κεντρικά. - Ωοειδής σχηματισμός ενδαρθρικά ~ 1 cm αναδεικνύεται προσθίως του προσθίου κέρατος του έξω μηνίσκου θα μπορούσε να παριστά χόνδρινης υφής ενδαρθρικό σωμάτιο. - Εντός του φυσιολογικού ελέγχεται ο λοιπός αρθρικός χόνδρος. - Μικρής έκτασης ασαφών ορίων οίδημα του οστικού μυελού του έσω μηριαίου κονδύλου παρά την κατάφυση της έσω κεφαλής του γαστροκνημίου αποδίδεται σε αποσπαστική κάκωση. - Με σήμα εντός του φυσιολογικού ελέγχεται ο λοιπός οστικός μυελός.

Indication: Pain.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 3.0 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Bone marrow signal is normal. No acute fracture or bone bruise.

JOINT SPACE:
Moderate joint effusion. Lobulated ganglion cysts from the medial and lateral gastrocnemius tendon origins. Minimal Baker cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: Cartilage appears intact.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: There is evidence of a small undersurface tear at the lateral meniscal body. Slight fraying of the inner margin along the posterior horn.
Lateral compartment cartilage: There is full-thickness cartilage fissuring at the central aspect of the lateral tibial plateau. Otherwise, cartilage appears intact.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: There is moderate cartilage loss at the lateral patellar facet and lateral trochlea. Cartilage thinning/fissuring is present at the median ridge of the patella and at the central trochlea. Medial patellofemoral cartilage appears intact.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: Mild edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. Slight lateral patellar subluxation. Patella alta. Findings suggest underlying patellar maltracking. The trochlear sulcus demonstrates normal depth. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 10 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:


1. Moderate patellofemoral chondrosis. Evidence of underlying patellar maltracking.

2. Evidence of a small tear of the lateral meniscus. Cartilage fissuring at the lateral tibial plateau.

3. Moderate joint effusion. Ganglion cysts arising from the medial and lateral gastrocnemius origins.

Conclusion: Old patellar injury, early osteoarthritis of lateral compartment. Bone marrow edema in the medial posterior part of lateral femoral condyl suggestive of contusion.

In the medial compartment, there is buckethandle tear of the medial meniscus, at the anterior horn, body and posterior horn. There is displaced meniscal fragment into the intercondylar notch. There is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The lateral compartment, there is longitudinal vertical oblique tear at the body and posterior horn of the lateral meniscus. There is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The patellofemoral joint, the patellar and trochlear cartilage appears congruent without chondral lesion. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
 In the intercondylar notch, there is complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact. There is no tibial translation. 
 There is grade II ligamentous sprain (partial tear) of the medial collateral ligament, at mid substance (deep and superficial fibers). The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact.  
 The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. The popliteofibular ligament is intact. The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact.  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.

HISTORY: Left knee pain. Arthralgia of left lower leg

COMPARISON: None.

PROCEDURE: MRI of the left knee with sagittal, coronal and axial images.

INTRAVENOUS CONTRAST: None

FINDINGS:

Large joint effusion. Trace popliteal cyst     

OSSEOUS STRUCTURES (excluding subchondral marrow):
Moderate subchondral edema in the medial tibial plateau without discrete subchondral fracture, in keeping with osseous stress response.No concerning bone marrow replacing lesion.Tiny tricompartmental marginal osteophytes.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT: 
Medial meniscus: Complete radial tear at junction of posterior horn and root with complex tearing extending into body and medial extrusion. Lateral meniscus: Intact. No discrete tear.
Cartilage: No high-grade cartilage loss.

Trochlear cartilage: Focal low-grade cartilage loss with heterogeneity in trochlear groove.

Quadriceps tendon: Intact.
Patellar tendon: Intact.
Retinaculum: Intact.

Hoffa's fat pad: Normal.

Lateral collateral ligament (LCL): Intact.
Posterolateral corner: Intact.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Intact.    
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Intact.

Mild insertional semimembranosus tendinosis..

MRI RIGHT KNEE:

INDICATION:    [Age] [Gender] with right knee pain giving way for one year worse going up and down stairs. No history of injury. Physiotherapy feels instability. Please assess for ligament damage.

PRIOR IMAGING: None.
.
TECHNICAL INFORMATION AND PROTOCOL:

Proton density and T2 weighted sagittal, coronal and axial imaging was performed through the knee including a 3D Fat suppressed proton density weighted sequence. No contrast was administered.

FINDINGS:

The 3-D proton density sequence was reformatted and manipulated to aid in the interpretation of this examination.

The extensor mechanism is intact.

There is mild thickening and increased T2 signal in the proximal fibers of the patellar tendon consistent with mild patellar tendinosis. There is also mild prepatellar edema consistent with prepatellar bursitis.

The patellofemoral ligaments are intact and appear unremarkable.

Articular cartilage of the patella demonstrates severe chondral fraying with some regions of focal cartilage loss seen to the lateral facet and apex of the patella. These changes are associated with subcortical cyst formation and edema seen to the patella involving lateral facet and apex.
The articular cartilage of the femoral trochlea is reasonably well-maintained apart from mild fissuring seen at the medial femoral trochlear articular surface.

The TT-TG distance is within normal limits.

The medial meniscus is intact. The articular cartilage of the medial joint compartment is reasonably well-maintained with only mild chondral fraying.

The lateral meniscus is intact. The articular cartilage of the lateral joint compartment is well-maintained.

The anterior cruciate ligament, posterior cruciate ligament, medial collateral ligament and lateral collateral ligament complex including IT band, fibular collateral ligament, popliteus tendon and biceps femoris tendon all appear intact and unremarkable.

There is a small ganglion cyst projecting posterior to the posterior cruciate ligament measuring 1.4 x 0.9 x 0.6 cm. Centrally within this ganglion cyst there is a small loose body measuring 6 mm.

No significant knee effusion is detected. No significant Baker's cyst.

INTERPRETATION: 

Severe chondrosis and involving the patellofemoral joint.

Mild patellar tendinosis. Associated prepatellar bursitis.

Mild chondrosis to the medial joint compartment.

Small ganglion cyst behind the posterior cruciate ligament with small loose body.
